reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount helpers; only the download step is a fresh per-provider function, following the tree's per-provider pattern.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions/downloadPluggyAiTransactions instead of a shared single-account download helper.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts and type in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; two small client edits (readable name, fintegra:false) are needed for Record<BankSyncProviders> typing but touch the client the request said was separate.

maintainability.why: Easy to own and consistent with siblings, though it grows the copy-per-provider download family by one more clone.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses linkBankSyncAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked like the other providers.

disguised_duplication.where: The download copy in sync.ts is an overt clone of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised.
